title: Give every worktree its own identity token, so no two workers share the fallback
goal: Eleven worktrees carry no susi.agent: the primary checkout, the old codex/devin/cloud-rsi trees and four .claude trees. who() falls back to the clone-wide user.name for all of them, so any two that claim share one refs/claim-agents entry, one task-id namespace, and can renew, close or release each other's claims (Mandate 50). scripts/susi-worktree.sh now states a worker's own token, but a tree that predates it — or one created any other way — still inherits the shared one, and nothing fails when it does. Assign each existing worktree a unique token derived from its own path, and make scripts/check-swarm-readiness.py fail rather than warn when a worktree carries none.
